mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log ( audit_log_id, actor_type_code, actor_id, action_type_code, target_table, target_id, before_data, after_data, change_reason, occurred_at ) VALUES ( seq_audit_log.NEXTVAL, 'ADMIN', #{revieweradminid}, 'REJECT', 'VEHICLE_CHANGE_REQUEST', #{vehiclechangerequestid}, #{beforedata, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{afterdata, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{reviewreason}, SYSDATE )

SELECT seq_vehicle.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO vehicle ( vehicle_id, office_id, vehicle_number, vehicle_model, owner_name, vehicle_type_code, registration_type_code, registration_status_code, registered_at, rejected_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{targetvehicleid}, #{officeid}, #{requestedvehiclenumber}, #{requestedvehiclemodel}, #{requestedownername}, #{requestedvehicletypecode}, 'ADDITIONAL', CASE WHEN #{requeststatuscode} = 'APPROVED' THEN 'REGISTERED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END, CASE WHEN #{requeststatuscode} = 'APPROVED' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{requeststatuscode} = 'REJECTED' THEN #{reviewreason} ELSE NULL END, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO vehicle_change_request ( vehicle_change_request_id, office_id, target_vehicle_id, request_type_code, requested_vehicle_number, requested_vehicle_model, requested_owner_name, requested_vehicle_type_code, request_reason, requested_at ) VALUES ( seq_vchange_req.NEXTVAL, #{officeid}, CASE WHEN #{requesttypecode} = 'ADD' THEN NULL ELSE #{targetvehicleid} END, #{requesttypecode}, #{requestedvehiclenumber}, #{requestedvehiclemodel}, #{requestedownername}, #{requestedvehicletypecode}, #{requestreason}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO vehicle_history ( vehicle_history_id, vehicle_id, office_id, vehicle_number, vehicle_model, owner_name, vehicle_type_code, registration_type_code, registration_status_code, registered_at, rejected_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, changed_by_admin_id, actor_type_code, actor_id, change_type_code, change_reason, valid_from, valid_to ) SELECT seq_vehicle_history.NEXTVAL, v.vehicle_id, v.office_id, v.vehicle_number, v.vehicle_model, v.owner_name, v.vehicle_type_code, v.registration_type_code, v.registration_status_code, v.registered_at, v.rejected_reason, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.deleted_at, #{revieweradminid}, 'ADMIN', #{revieweradminid}, CASE WHEN #{requeststatuscode} = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECT' ELSE 'APPROVE' END, #{reviewreason}, SYSDATE, NULL FROM vehicle v WHERE v.vehicle_id = #{targetvehicleid}
mapper.select: SELECT vehicle_change_request_id AS vehiclechangerequestid, office_id AS officeid, target_vehicle_id AS targetvehicleid, request_type_code AS requesttypecode, requested_vehicle_number AS requestedvehiclenumber, requested_vehicle_model AS requestedvehiclemodel, requested_owner_name AS requestedownername, requested_vehicle_type_code AS requestedvehicletypecode, request_reason AS requestreason, request_status_code AS requeststatuscode FROM vehicle_change_request WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid}

SELECT vcr.vehicle_change_request_id AS vehiclechangerequestid, vcr.office_id AS officeid, o.office_number AS officenumber, vcr.target_vehicle_id AS targetvehicleid, vcr.request_type_code AS requesttypecode, vcr.requested_vehicle_number AS requestedvehiclenumber, vcr.requested_vehicle_model AS requestedvehiclemodel, vcr.requested_owner_name AS requestedownername, vcr.requested_vehicle_type_code AS requestedvehicletypecode, vcr.request_reason AS requestreason, vcr.request_status_code AS requeststatuscode, vcr.reviewer_admin_id AS revieweradminid, vcr.review_reason AS reviewreason, vcr.requested_at AS requestedat, vcr.reviewed_at AS reviewedat, vcr.applied_at AS appliedat FROM vehicle_change_request vcr LEFT JOIN office o ON vcr.office_id = o.office_id ORDER BY vcr.requested_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle_change_request SET request_status_code = #{requeststatuscode}, reviewer_admin_id = #{revieweradminid}, review_reason = #{reviewreason}, reviewed_at = SYSDATE WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_status_code = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE vehicle v SET registration_status_code = ( SELECT CASE WHEN request_status_code = 'APPROVED' THEN 'REGISTERED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END FROM vehicle_change_request WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_type_code = 'ADD' ), registered_at = ( SELECT CASE WHEN request_status_code = 'APPROVED' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END FROM vehicle_change_request WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_type_code = 'ADD' ), rejected_reason = ( SELECT CASE WHEN request_status_code = 'REJECTED' THEN review_reason ELSE NULL END FROM vehicle_change_request WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_type_code = 'ADD' ), updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE v.vehicle_id = ( SELECT target_vehicle_id FROM vehicle_change_request WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_type_code = 'ADD' )

UPDATE vehicle_history h SET valid_to = SYSDATE WHERE h.vehicle_id = ( SELECT target_vehicle_id FROM vehicle_change_request WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} ) AND h.valid_to IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_history ( vehicle_history_id, vehicle_id, office_id, vehicle_number, vehicle_model, owner_name, vehicle_type_code, registration_type_code, registration_status_code, registered_at, rejected_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, changed_by_admin_id, actor_type_code, actor_id, change_type_code, change_reason, valid_from, valid_to ) SELECT seq_vehicle_history.NEXTVAL, v.vehicle_id, v.office_id, v.vehicle_number, v.vehicle_model, v.owner_name, v.vehicle_type_code, v.registration_type_code, v.registration_status_code, v.registered_at, v.rejected_reason, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.deleted_at, r.reviewer_admin_id, 'ADMIN', r.reviewer_admin_id, CASE WHEN r.request_status_code = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECT' WHEN r.request_type_code = 'ADD' THEN 'APPROVE' WHEN r.request_type_code = 'DELETE' THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'UPDATE' END, r.review_reason, SYSDATE, NULL FROM vehicle_change_request r JOIN vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id = r.target_vehicle_id WHERE r.vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid}
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle_change_request SET request_status_code = 'CANCELLED' WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehicle_change_request_id} AND request_status_code = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE vehicle_change_request SET applied_at = SYSDATE WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND applied_at IS NULL
